title: V1 freeze backend fixes: delete integrity, token revocation, runtime robustness
goal: Fix every backend issue found by the V1 freeze deep review (maintainer decision: all known issues fixed before release): orphan data on delete paths, missing token revocation on user delete/disable, and the load-degradation paths (sync oplog fallback, unbounded exports, no graceful shutdown, no general rate limit).

in: Role delete purges system_role_data_scope (+ legacy table) in-tx; pre-checks locked in-tx
User delete cascades profile_ext, password history, MFA factor/challenge; menu delete removes last-owner role-permission keys
Dept/post delete pre-checks moved inside transactions with row locks
Dynamic module unregister/purge transactional with retryable DROP TABLE ordering
Redis token blacklist writer + refresh cascade on delete/disable/batch-disable/password-reset
Redis documented as hard dependency (DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE + startup warning)
Operation-log queue: drop-with-metric instead of sync fallback; drain on shutdown
CSV export 10k row caps + request-context propagation (user/role/dept)
General per-IP API rate limiter on /api/v1 with env overrides; memory-store eviction
out: GORM WithContext sweep beyond export paths (carried past V1)
Smoke coverage gap closure (separate task 2026-07-26 smoke batches)
SonarCloud S3776/S4666 remediation (separate Sonar zero-out batches)

minimumViableApproach: Three stacked PRs merged in order: (1) fix/v1-freeze-delete-integrity — delete-path orphan cleanup, transactional pre-checks, migration 000011; (2) fix/v1-freeze-token-revocation — blacklist writer wired to every disable/delete path plus Redis hard-dependency docs; (3) fix/v1-freeze-runtime-robustness — oplog queue policy, graceful shutdown, export caps, general rate limiter.
successCriteria: Deleting a role removes its data-scope policy rows; re-creating the same role_key starts from scope 'all' (regression test).
Deleting a user leaves no rows in profile_ext / password_history / auth_factor / mfa_challenge and revokes live Redis tokens immediately (blacklist checked per request incl. cache hits).
Disabling a user (single, batch, or via update) revokes tokens and sessions; admin password reset revokes tokens.
Menu delete removes role-permission keys only when the menu was the key's last owner.
Dept/post/role delete guards run inside transactions with row locks; mid-tx failure rolls back fully (regression test).
Module unregister/purge leave no half-states; failed DROP TABLE is retryable via purge with registration intact.
Operation-log queue overflow drops with pantheon_operation_log_dropped_total instead of blocking mutating requests; queued entries drain on SIGTERM.
user/role/dept exports capped at 10000 rows and cancellable via request context.
Full backend suite green against real MySQL (the two known local-Redis env-conditional failures reproduce identically on clean main and are documented in evidence).
deferredCodeIssues: Carried past V1 with documented rationale: full GORM WithContext sweep (only export paths done), GetLocationByIP stub, dept export cap applies pre-tree-filter (noted in code), TOCTOU residual for concurrent child INSERT under REPEATABLE READ (parent row lock does not block it; create paths would need to lock the parent).
